hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Determine the minimum subarray length having cumulative bitwise or of at least k under large input constraints.

hints.title: Bit Tracking
hints.text: Represent the bitwise or of the active range using thirty-two counters indicating how many elements contribute to each bit position.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Contraction
hints.text: Expand the right boundary by incrementing bit counters. Whenever the value matches or exceeds k, record length and advance the left pointer.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Each element enters and exits the window at most once with 32 operations per transition.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) brute force subarray evaluation causes time limit exceeded on large arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use thirty-two bit counters to achieve linear time complexity.
